claim_formal: ∀ finite S, ∀ Coxeter matrix M on S: the universal cover of the Salvetti complex X(W,S) is contractible (π_n X(W,S)=0 for n≥2)

quote_A.text: For every Coxeter matrix on a finite set S, the universal cover of X(W,S) is contractible.

quote_B.text: This resolves the Artin K(\pi,1) conjecture in finite rank.

notes: Headline = K(π,1) conjecture in finite rank. Family also proves the Parabolic Intersection Conjecture (∀ M1, P1/O1) and refutes the CAT(0) conjecture for Artin groups with an explicit 116-generator group (∃ M3, P1/O2). Lean HarmonicArtin states contractibility of a nerve model of the Salvetti cover for [Finite S].

claim_formal: ∀ f.g. virtually polycyclic P, ∀ f.g. group H: H quasi-isometric to P → H virtually polycyclic

quote_A.text: If H and P are quasi-isometric, then H is virtually polycyclic.

quote_B.text: This resolves the lattice-recognition conjecture of Eskin, Fisher and Whyte

notes: Lean group_recognition uses coarse equivalence of f.g. groups (equivalent to QI) and also includes the uniform-lattice conclusion, so it matches/slightly strengthens the headline.

claim_formal: ∀ group G, ∀ 1≤m≤n, ∀ w_1..w_m ∈ G*F_n with rank_ℚ(exponent-sum matrix)=m: G → (G*F_n)/⟨⟨w_1..w_m⟩⟩ is injective (equivalently ∃ overgroup containing a simultaneous solution)

quote_A.text: If their exponent-sum matrix has row rank m over Q, then the canonical homomorphism G → (G*F_n)/⟨⟨w_1,…,w_m⟩⟩ is injective.

quote_B.text: This proves Howie's conjecture on nonsingular systems.

notes: Matrix could also be read as M2 (∀∃: a solution exists in an overgroup); formal theorem is injectivity so M1. Companion proves the Kervaire conjecture (unimodular coefficient injectivity, P1/O1). Lean Kervaire covers only the one-equation unimodular case (exponent sum ±1), a special case of Howie's statement.

claim_formal: ∃ finite 2-dim aspherical simplicial complex K, ∃ C: linear disk filling in K̃ (so π_1K hyperbolic) ∧ π_1K admits no geometric action on any proper complete CAT(0) space

quote_A.text: There exist a finite connected two-dimensional aspherical simplicial complex K and a constant C<∞ … π_1K admits no geometric action on a proper complete CAT(0) space.

quote_B.text: Answers negatively whether every word-hyperbolic group is a CAT(0) group.

notes: Gromov's realization question; CAT(-1) version is Problem H11 in Baumslag–Myasnikov–Shpilrain list (could argue P3), CAT(0) version is listed in surveys only, so P2. Existence proof via random presentations; size of K not effective.

claim_formal: ∀ finite X, ∀ r ∈ F(X): (⟨X|r⟩ contains no BS(m,n), m,n≠0) → ⟨X|r⟩ word-hyperbolic

quote_A.text: If the one-relator group G=⟨X|r⟩ contains no subgroup isomorphic to BS(m,n) for any nonzero integers m,n, then G is word-hyperbolic.

quote_B.text: We prove Gersten's conjecture

notes: Companion: every hyperbolic one-relator group is virtually compact special (∀ M1); combined with Kielak–Linton gives Wise's virtual free-by-cyclic conjecture for hyperbolic one-relator groups.

claim_formal: ∃ f.g. group Γ, ∃ two essentially free p.m.p. actions of Γ with different costs (Cost(Γ↷X) ≥ 1+η > 1+99/M ≥ Cost(Γ↷Y_M))

quote_A.text: gives two essentially free p.m.p. actions of the same finitely generated group with strictly different costs. Thus the general fixed-price assertion is false.

quote_B.text: This gives a negative answer to Gaboriau's general fixed-price problem.

notes: Explicit group (amalgam of F_100 with J×Z) and explicit constants. Fixed-price problem posed as a question by Gaboriau; P1 also defensible if read as the 'fixed price conjecture'.

claim_formal: ∀ n≥3, ∀ smooth one-ended initial-data exterior (Ω^n,g,K) with DEC, weakly future trapped boundary, stated decay, E>|P| and A_min>0: m ≥ ½ (A_min/ω_{n-1})^{(n-2)/(n-1)}, with sharp coefficient and exponent (equality for Schwarzschild slices)

quote_A.text: Then m ≥ ½ (A_{min,g}(S)/ω_{n-1})^{(n-2)/(n-1)}. The coefficient and exponent are sharp in each dimension n≥3.

quote_B.text: We prove the sharp spacetime Penrose inequality for smooth one-ended initial-data exteriors in every spatial dimension n ≥ 3

notes: M1/M8 also defensible (inequality between given quantities); sharpness/rigidity pushes to M9. Outcome O1 vs O5: proves the spacetime Penrose conjecture in the Bray–Khuri enclosing-area formulation but only for one-ended data under decay and positive-enclosing-area hypotheses (finitely many ends handled in n=3,4). 13 manuscripts: charged, Kerr–Newman (with counterexamples for slow EM tails), AdS, rigidity. Lean comparator CKSBondiPenrose concerns the Bondi-mass version in the CKS class (secondary); the comparator text is truncated with no theorem visible.

claim_formal: ∀ h>0, almost surely (v_x iid uniform on [-h,h]): the 2D Anderson operator H_v on ℓ²(ℤ²) has pure-point spectrum (complete eigenbasis) and σ(H_v)=[-4-h,4+h]

quote_A.text: For each fixed h>0, almost surely H_v has pure-point spectral type, admits a complete orthonormal eigenbasis, and has spectrum σ(H_v)=[-4-h,4+h].

quote_B.text: This resolves the pure-point assertion of the two-dimensional Anderson localization conjecture for the uniform single-site law.

notes: Headline taken as the 2D pure-point result (listed first in summary). Posed as Simon's Problem 2 (numbered list; P3 defensible). Outcome only for uniform single-site law and spectral (not dynamical) localization, so O5 possible. Companion: d≥3 weak disorder purely a.c. spectrum on a fixed interval (Simon Problem 1 energy-range question). Lean anderson_spectrum_ae only states σ(H)=[-4-h,4+h] a.s., not pure-point type.

claim_formal: ∀ γ∈(1/2,3/2), ∀ m≥1, ∀ measurable Hermitian PSD W:ℝ→ℂ^{m×m} with ∫tr W^{γ+1/2}<∞: Tr(H_W)_-^γ ≤ C_γ ∫ tr W^{γ+1/2}, C_γ the scalar one-bound-state constant, optimal for every m (attained by sech² potential); equality iff W is a constant-unitary direct sum of scalar sech² solitons and zero channels

quote_A.text: The constant is optimal in every matrix dimension. With r=(γ-1/2)^{-1}, it is attained by W(x)=diag((r+1)sech²(rx),0,…,0).

quote_B.text: We resolve affirmatively the remaining cases of the scalar one-dimensional Lieb–Thirring conjecture: for every 1/2<γ<3/2, the optimal constant is the one-bound-state constant.

notes: Headline per summary is the matrix version plus equality classification; posed problem is the scalar 1D Lieb–Thirring conjecture (γ=1 had been done by Read–Schulz 2026), which the family settles for all remaining γ; matrix version is an extension (O8 defensible). Lean sharp_lieb_thirring is the scalar (m=1) case only.

claim_formal: ∃ universal C, ∀ M≥1, ∀ distinct nuclear positions, ∀ charges z_j≥1 (Z=Σz_j), ∀ n≥1: E_n<E_{n-1} → n ≤ Z+CM

quote_A.text: There is a universal finite constant C such that every nuclear system specified above and every integer n≥1 satisfy E_n<E_{n-1} ⟹ n≤Z+CM.

quote_B.text: The theorem resolves positively the excess-charge form of the ionization conjecture in this strict-binding formulation

notes: Ionization conjecture is also Simon's Problem 9 (numbered list; P3 defensible). C not stated to be explicit, so no effective/ineffective flag. Family also proves two-sided bounds on first ionization energy and outer radius, and the generalized ionization conjecture (energy and radius asymptotics). Lean comparators CoulombIonization (generalized ionization energy limits) and CoulombRadii (radius asymptotics) are secondary results, not the excess-charge bound.

claim_formal: ∀ M>0, ∀ 0<|a|<M, ∃ ε>0, for comeagre (residual) data d in the weighted-smooth ε-neighbourhood of the two-ended Kerr bridge: the maximal globally hyperbolic development of d has no future C^0∩W^{1,2}_loc extension

quote_A.text: the set of d∈U_ε for which the full development (M_d,g_d) admits a future extension … is meagre in U_ε.

quote_B.text: Proves local strong cosmic censorship near each fixed rotating subextremal Kerr bridge.

notes: M1 (inextendibility as a property of generic data) is an alternative to M4. Strong cosmic censorship (Christodoulou W^{1,2} formulation) settled only locally near Kerr. Companion papers give C^1 and C^2 versions.

claim_formal: ∀ q,R,J,Δ>0, ∃ C=C(q,R,J,Δ), ∀ finite induced square-lattice domain Λ, ∀ finite-range H with unique ground state Ω and global gap ≥Δ, ∀ A⊆Λ: S_Ω(A) ≤ C|∂_Λ A|

quote_A.text: For every A⊆Λ, S_Ω(A) ≤ C|∂_Λ A|. The same constant applies to all such domains, sets, and Hamiltonians.

quote_B.text: We prove an entropy area law for the unique ground state of a finite-range Hamiltonian on any finite induced subgraph of the square lattice.

notes: Area-law conjecture for gapped ground states is posed in all dimensions; 2D settled (O5 + restricted_range by rule 6); O1 if the 2D case is regarded as its own posed problem. Intro's history section is empty in the input, so the posing is not quoted. Companion: PEPS approximation with poly(L) bond dimension.

claim_formal: N(6) = 3, i.e. 3 MUBs exist in ℂ^6 and no 4 pairwise mutually unbiased orthonormal bases of ℂ^6 exist

quote_A.text: certifies that there are no four pairwise mutually unbiased orthonormal bases in C^6. Consequently, N(6)=3.

quote_B.text: We prove that the maximum number of mutually unbiased orthonormal bases in ℂ6 is three, resolving Zauner's dimension-six MUB conjecture.

notes: Computer-assisted upper bound under stated binary64 arithmetic/compiler conditions (not a mathematical hypothesis, so no conditional_on). Lean MUBSix proves only the companion's results: Fourier-vanishing conjecture of Matolcsi–Ruzsa–Weiner and N(6)≤5 (weaker one-sided bound); HadamardCubeFiber also secondary.

claim_formal: ∀ a>0, ∃ ρ_*(a)>0, ∀ 0<ρ<ρ_*, ∃ T=T(a,ρ)>0: liminf_{L→∞, N/L³→ρ} ⟨u_0,γ^{(1)}_{N,L,T}u_0⟩/N > 0 for the 3D hard-sphere canonical Gibbs state

quote_A.text: there is a fixed temperature T=T(a,ρ)>0 for which liminf … ⟨u_{0,L},γ^{(1)}_{N,L,T}u_{0,L}⟩/N > 0.

quote_B.text: We prove Bose–Einstein condensation at positive temperature in the three-dimensional dilute hard-sphere gas.

notes: M2 (existence of a temperature with condensation) also defensible. Proving BEC at positive temperature for an interacting gas is a long-standing open problem; result is only for dilute density and some small T, hence O5. Family also proves Bogoliubov quantum depletion law at T=0. Lean HardSphere appears to formalize ground-state (T=0) condensation from the companion paper, not the positive-temperature headline (truncated comparator).

claim_formal: ∀ even L≥60: the spin-1 antiferromagnetic Heisenberg ring H_L has a unique ground state and gap γ_L > (4/105)log(80/79); hence liminf γ_L ≥ log20/784 > 0

quote_A.text: γ_L > (4/105) log(80/79) for every even L≥60

quote_B.text: establishing the positive even-periodic formulation of the spin-one Haldane conjecture.

notes: Outcome could be read as O5 (even periodic rings only; odd/open chains via a companion with boundary field). Explicit threshold L≥60 → ∀ + effective (rule 2).

claim_formal: ∃ N_0, ∀ N≥N_0, Q=3(N-1): H_{N,Q} ≥ (1/25)(I − P_Laughlin) on ∧^N U_Q (V1 Hamiltonian on the sphere at filling 1/3)

quote_A.text: There is an integer N_0≥2 such that, for every N≥N_0 and Q=3(N−1), H_{N,Q} ≥ (1/25)(I−P_{L,N})

quote_B.text: We prove the spherical fermionic Laughlin spectral-gap conjecture for the full V1 interaction.

notes: Gap constant 1/25 explicit but threshold N_0 existential, so no effective flag. Companion proves stability of the gap under weak bounded scalar disorder. Lean LaughlinGap thm_main matches (other comparators: weaker 1/100 version, Fock inequality, planar gap).

claim_formal: ∀ N≥2: dim Ker H_N = 1 for relative SU(N) BFSS matrix QM (exactly one normalizable zero-energy state, Spin(9)-invariant)

quote_A.text: For every integer N≥2, dim Ker H_N = 1.

quote_B.text: This establishes the threshold-bound-state conjecture.

notes: Alternatively prefix ∀ with M9 (exact value of dim Ker). Companion proves infinitely many positive-energy eigenstates for SU(2), refuting a claim in the original BFSS paper.

claim_formal: ∀ S∈{1/2,1,3/2,…}, ∀ nonnegative symmetric finite-range J on ℤ³ whose support generates ℤ³: lim_{β→∞} β^{3/2}(S − m_{S,J}(β)) = ζ(3/2)/(8π^{3/2}√det D_{S,J})

quote_B.text: We prove Bloch's T3/2 law for the spontaneous magnetization of three-dimensional quantum Heisenberg ferromagnets at every fixed positive quantum spin.

notes: Bloch's law is a physical prediction (P1 as a predicted answer; P2 possible). Family also proves spontaneous magnetization for d≥3 (low-temperature ordering problem), the first lattice correction, and the spherical magnetization law. Lean Heisenberg formalizes the spontaneous-magnetization KMS-state result (secondary).

claim_formal: ∃ entangled ρ on ℂ^10⊗ℂ^10 (explicit): K_D(ρ)=0 for all admitted local-instrument protocols with two-way public communication

quote_A.text: There is an explicitly specified entangled density operator ρ on C^10⊗C^10 whose range contains no nonzero product vector and for which K_D(ρ)=0.

quote_B.text: We construct an entangled state on ℂ10⊗ℂ10 with zero distillable secret key for the local-instrument protocols specified here.

notes: Answers negatively the question whether every entangled state has positive distillable key (rule 5 → M3). Result holds for the paper's specified protocol class. Also disproves the unrestricted two-map PPT-composition conjecture and Christandl's PPT-square conjecture (TP PPT channel on M_21 whose square is not entanglement breaking; P1/O2). Lean DimensionTenPair/DimensionTenChannel formalize the PPT-map results, not the key statement.

claim_formal: ∀ n≥1, ∀ finite-energy n-mode states ρ_A,ρ_B, ∀ η∈[0,1]: g^{-1}(S(ρ_C)/n) ≥ η g^{-1}(S(ρ_A)/n) + (1−η) g^{-1}(S(ρ_B)/n) for the beam-splitter output ρ_C

quote_B.text: This resolves the entropy photon-number conjecture in this finite-energy setting

notes: Equality for thermal inputs could push to M9; kept M1 as an inequality between given quantities. Corollaries: minimum output entropy of thermal attenuator tensor powers, capacity region of degraded pure-loss broadcast channel.

claim_formal: PARITY ∉ QAC^0: ∀ d,c,ε>0, for all sufficiently large n, no depth-d circuit with ≤n^c qubits (1-qubit gates + unbounded Toffoli, measured single output) computes parity with advantage ε on every input

quote_A.text: For all sufficiently large n, no circuit of depth at most d on n input qubits and at most n^c total qubits … computes parity(x) with probability at least 1/2+ε for every x

quote_B.text: This resolves Moore's parity conjecture in the measured-output model.

notes: Prefix could be written ∀∀^∞ from the theorem's quantifiers; chose none as a class-separation statement about named objects. Measured-output model is more permissive than Moore's clean-ancilla model, so the original conjecture also follows. Lean QACParity matches; RegularParity is the fixed-2/3 version.

claim_formal: Approximating the ground-energy infimum of the 3D clamped-nucleus electronic Coulomb Hamiltonian over the full spinful fermionic continuum space is QMA-hard under deterministic poly-time many-one reductions (even with unit nuclear charges, rational positions, threshold separation ≥1)

quote_A.text: is QMA-hard under deterministic classical polynomial-time many-one reductions.

quote_B.text: The supplied basis restricts the admissible many-electron states, as the authors emphasize in their discussion of the infinite-dimensional problem in Section~V.

notes: No explicit posing found in the input; continuum hardness was flagged as open by O'Gorman et al. (P2), P5 also defensible. Two manuscripts: binary charges and unit charges. Lean comparator ContinuumCoulombHardness is truncated in the input (main theorem not visible); assumed to match.

quote_A.text: In particular, C(A_{γ,ν})=χ(A_{γ,ν}).

quote_B.text: Leditzky, Kaur, Datta, and Wilde identified its unrestricted classical capacity as an open problem in their 2018 study of approximate additivity.

notes: Corollary: additivity of Holevo capacity, minimum output entropy and classical capacity with any finite-dimensional partner channel.

claim_formal: ∃ universal κ_0>0, ∀ finite two-player game G with ω*(G)=v<1, ∀ 0<δ<1−v, ∀ k≥1, ∀ finite-dim joint strategy: Pr[W_k ≥ ⌈(v+δ)k⌉] ≤ exp(−κ_0 δ^5 k/(1+log|A||B|))

quote_A.text: Pr[W_k ≥ ⌈(v+δ)k⌉] ≤ exp(−κ_0δ^5 k/(1+log d)).

quote_B.text: Threshold parallel repetition asks whether the probability that the fraction of wins exceeds the single-game value by any fixed positive amount is exponentially small.

notes: Proof combines a new conditioning-to-threshold transfer with Song's (2026) conditioning estimate. Second bound with explicit cubic rate depending on μ. Lean states rate δ^13 instead of δ^5, so weaker.

claim_formal: ∃ three-electron Coulomb molecule (two equal integer nuclear charges Z, specified non-numerically): its absolute ground-state density n_Ψ ≠ n_Γ for every v∈L^{3/2}+L^∞ and every noninteracting ground-state ensemble Γ of H_s(v)

quote_A.text: there is no v∈V and no ground-state ensemble Γ of H_s(v) such that n_Γ=n_Ψ almost everywhere on R^3.

quote_B.text: This disproves Kohn–Sham ensemble representability for that potential class

notes: Charge Z exists by an exact non-numerical formula ('no effective numerical bound for the charge'). Representability is a long-standing assumption/question of DFT (v-representability problem), taken as P2; P1 defensible. Result restricted to potential class L^{3/2}+L^∞.

claim_formal: ∃ poly-time uniform family of poly-size quantum circuits over the fixed gate set {NOT,CNOT,Toffoli,H,diag(1,i), inverses, controlled versions}, ∀ N≥2: the circuit outputs the complete prime factorization of N with probability 1

quote_A.text: There is a polynomial-time uniform family of polynomial-size quantum circuits that outputs the complete prime factorization of every input integer N≥2 with probability one.

quote_B.text: The present construction addresses certainty and worst-case polynomial bounds in a specified exact gate model.

notes: Whether factoring is in exact quantum polynomial time over a finite gate set is a known open question, but the input contains no explicit posing; P5 defensible. Matrix M10 as algorithm existence (M2 possible).

claim_formal: ∀ simple unitary strongly rational VOA V over ℂ: V is energy-bounded and strongly local, generates a completely rational conformal net A_V, is completely unitary, and Rep(V) ≃ Rep^f(A_V) as braided unitary tensor categories

quote_A.text: V has polynomial energy bounds and is CKLW-strongly local. The algebras (eq) form an irreducible conformal net A_V.

quote_B.text: Proves the strongly rational case of the strong-locality conjecture

notes: The full CKLW strong-locality conjecture is for all simple unitary VOAs; only the strongly rational case is settled (O5). Also gives a braided tensor equivalence (M7 content). Lean comparator VertexAlgebraNet is truncated in the input (theorem not visible); assumed to match the headline.

claim_formal: lim_{p→∞} Q_p = P_* for QAOA on the zero-field Gaussian SK model, thermodynamic limit first: ∀ ε>0 ∃ p, ∃ deterministic angles γ,β∈ℝ^p independent of n and J with v_p(γ,β) ≥ P_* − ε

quote_A.text: lim_{p→∞} Q_p = P_*. Equivalently, for every ε>0 there exist a finite integer p and deterministic real vectors γ,β∈R^p, independent of n and J, such that v_p(γ,β) ≥ P_*−ε.

quote_B.text: This proves the eventual Parisi-optimality conjecture of Basso, Farhi, Marwaha, Villalonga, and Zhou in its fixed-parameter thermodynamic formulation.

notes: Prefix alternatively ∀∃ from the ε-form. No quantitative depth bound ('We give no quantitative bound on the required depth'). Corollary: optimal leading-order MaxCut on large-degree random regular graphs. Lean SKValue/SKFullSupport formalize the zero-temperature Parisi minimizer full-support result (companion), not the QAOA limit.

claim_formal: ∀ 4D unitary positive-energy QFT satisfying the framework (discrete bounded-below scaling spectrum with finite multiplicities, finite scaling support, bounded local net with affiliated fields, physical local dilatation current): ∃ physical scalar L of dimension 2 with T^μ_μ-improvement t_{μν} symmetric, conserved, traceless, same Poincaré charges (scale ⇒ local conformal Ward identities)

quote_A.text: Then the physical stress tensor admits a local symmetric conserved improvement with the same translation and Lorentz Ward charges and with zero trace.

quote_B.text: We prove that scale symmetry implies local conformal symmetry for a class of four-dimensional unitary, positive-energy quantum field theories

notes: The scale-implies-conformal question in 4D is a well-known conjecture/open question, but the input does not name it; the result is for a restricted class under strong structural hypotheses and gives only local Ward identities, so O5 (conditional_on could also be argued for the reconstruction hypotheses). Prefix could be ∀∃ (existence of L).

claim_formal: ∃ polynomial p and a deterministic poly-time algorithm producing, for each n, an oracle circuit A_n over {H,T,T†,CNOT} with ≤p(n) qubits, gates and queries, such that ∀ U∈U(2^n) ∃ Boolean f: ‖Φ_{n,f} − U‖_◇ ≤ 1/2

quote_A.text: For every unitary U∈U(2^n) there is a function f:{0,1}^{m(n)}→{0,1} for which the output channel Φ_{n,f} of A_n^{O_f} satisfies ‖Φ_{n,f}−U‖_◇ ≤ 1/2.

quote_B.text: We give a positive answer to the constant-error formulation of the Aaronson–Kuperberg unitary synthesis problem.

notes: Problem posed in Aaronson–Kuperberg 2007 Section 7 Problem (4) and Aaronson 2021 open-problems survey Problem 6 (P3 defensible). Only the constant-error formulation is answered (O5); O1 if constant error is regarded as the posed problem. M2 also defensible (existence of circuit + oracle).

claim_formal: α_tot = 4: R(f)=O((1+Q(f))^4) for all total Boolean f, and ∀ k≥2 ∃ total F_{k,m} with Q ≤ C_k√m (log m)^{b_k}, R ≥ c_k m^{2−1/k}/(log m)^2, so no exponent α<4 works

quote_A.text: The optimal power is α_tot=4.

quote_B.text: They conjectured that randomized complexity satisfies the stronger relation R(f)=O(Q(f)^3). Theorem~\ref{thm:main} disproves that conjecture

notes: Refutes ABKRT21 Conjecture 2 (cubic) and determines the true exponent (rule 7 → O3). Upper bound was already known (ABKRT21); new content is the nearly-quartic separating family (could be read ∃ M3). Constants c_k,C_k not explicit.
